title: Supreme Court Legal Aid Committee ... vs Union Of India (Uoi) And Ors. on 7 October, 1994
acts_list: Section 309 of the Code and Articles
outcome_summary: The court held that detention of foreign nationals without a speedy trial was illegal and void.
key_reasons: Delay in trials can lead to violation of fundamental rights under Articles 14, 19, and 21 of the Constitution
